newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pasminco sees Budel permit very soon.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pasminco sees Budel permit very soon.

text.p: Base metals group Pasminco Ltd, which earlier on Thursday said it would acquire the Century zinc project for A$345 million, said it expected that Dutch authorities would grant an extension of its Budel zinc smelter operating licence within weeks.
"We expect the formal licence shortly," Pasminco managing director David Stewart told reporters.
The company has applied for an extension to the year 2000 which would enable Budel to continue dumping the waste byproduct jarosite until that time.
Asked when he expected the licence extension, Stewart said: "I would expect weeks."

The deadline for dumping was mid-1999 but Pasminco applied for extension as this would allow the smelter to start taking production from Century. The Century product has a low iron content which is necessary for Budel if it is to halt jarosite dumping.

Pasminco said it would acquire the Century project in northern Queensland from RTZ-CRA, with the deal subject to successful talks with aboriginal groups who have claimed ownership of land in the region.
